follow-up time: Participants were followed until age 19-24 years
cohort: The study involved participants who were first examined in Munich and Dresden in 1995/1996 at age 9-11 years.
finding: Cesarean section was associated with BHR in early adulthood, while assisted birth was associated with asthma symptoms, FE symptoms, doctor's diagnosis of atopic dermatitis in childhood, and sensitization in early adulthood.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with increased risk of bronchial hyperreactivity in early adulthood, and assisted birth was associated with increased risks of asthma, flexural eczema, atopic dermatitis in childhood, and sensitization in early adulthood.
birth_weight: Mentioned as lower birthweight and higher birthweight
